gloss: main ingredient in a clear soup

definitions.gloss: wandane; main ingredient of a clear soup
definitions.explanation: The central, showcased ingredient placed in a lacquered soup bowl for {吸|す}い{物|もの} (clear soup) — typically fish, shrimp, tofu, or another item chosen to be the visual and flavor centerpiece of the dish.

examples.japanese: {椀種|わんだね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Seasonal fish is used as the wandane.

examples.japanese: ⟦{懐石|かいせき}→懐石：12635_kaiseki⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{椀種|わんだね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{選|えら}び⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{板前|いたまえ}→板前：13118_itamae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: In kaiseki cuisine, the choice of wandane shows the chef's skill.

notes:
{椀種|わんだね} (bowl + ingredient/seed) is the featured main ingredient of a ⟦{吸|す}い{物|もの}→吸い物：04990_suimono⟧ (clear soup), around which the broth, garnish, and seasoning are built.

A clear soup is structured in three parts:
- {椀種|わんだね}: the main ingredient (fish, shrimp, tofu, etc.)
- {椀妻|わんづま}: the vegetable or secondary garnish
- ⟦{吸|す}い{口|くち}→吸い口：30944_suikuchi⟧: the aromatic top garnish, such as ⟦{木|き}の{芽|め}→木の芽：30945_kinome⟧

Choosing and preparing the {椀種|わんだね} well is considered a mark of skill in formal Japanese cooking, especially ⟦{懐石|かいせき}→懐石：12635_kaiseki⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧.
